newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Chevalier Int'l gets govt housing project.
newsitem.headline: Chevalier Int'l gets govt housing project.

text.p: Chevalier International Holdings Ltd said its unit Good Process Ltd has been granted a site for a residential and commercial development under the government's Home Ownership Scheme (HOS).

The company said it will pay a premium of HK$380 million to the government under the Private Sector Participation Scheme of the HOS for building 12 residential blocks, a commercial complex, a kindergarten and 402 parking spaces in Tuen Mun.
The total cost for developing the site, including the premium, would be about HK$1.4 billion and it would provide 3,020 residential units for qualified families, it said.
Chevalier International has a 49 percent direct interest in Good Process and its subsidiary Chevalier Development International Ltd holds the remaining 51 percent, the comany said in a statement.
The Chevalier group planned to finance the project by bank borrowings and internal resources of the companies, it added.
